nodes.label: Appraise-Owned Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: AppraiseJS owns lifecycle and business rules, so agents must use Appraise-managed diagnostics, review, approval, validation, and completion gates rather than local files, database edits, raw JSON-RPC, or chat approval.

nodes.label: Durable Continuation State
nodes.rationale: Complete handoff metadata and sequence cursors allow a later turn to resume the same bounded approval wait without losing revision identity or lifecycle state.
